The refactor is localized to [walk_dir_tree.go](/app/scanner/walk_dir_tree.go:31), [tag_scanner.go](/app/scanner/tag_scanner.go:85), and [paths.go](/app/utils/paths.go:9). `loadDir`, symlink and ignore checks, and the readability helper still use direct OS calls. `Scan` also owns the walker through `getRootFolderWalker`; that channel setup belongs in `Scan` when `walkDirTree` takes an `fs.FS` and returns the results and error channels.

A fix needs to preserve child-first traversal, ignore markers, error reporting, and the paths used by scanner processing. Symlink behavior needs particular care: the existing fixture expects a symlink to a directory to be visited, while behavior across arbitrary `fs.FS` implementations remains unverified.

The focused existing walker tests passed offline. I recorded the diagnosis in `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`. **No project source or tests were edited**; this specialist pass was limited to fault localization.

Refactored the directory walker to use `fs.FS` for traversal and directory checks. `Scan` now creates the filesystem and consumes the walker’s results and error channels directly. I removed `getRootFolderWalker` and `utils.IsDirReadable`, and added an in-memory filesystem test for child-first traversal and output paths.

The scanner and utils tests pass offline, and `git diff --check` is clean.

VERDICT: FIX

[loadDir](/app/scanner/walk_dir_tree.go:80) assumes that a directory opened through `fs.FS` implements `fs.ReadDirFile`. The `fs.FS` interface does not guarantee that, so a valid implementation can panic during traversal. Use `fs.ReadDir` or check the interface and return an error when directory reading is unsupported.

`go test ./scanner` and `go test ./utils` both passed. The existing tests do not cover this case. TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none. As an independent reviewer, I did not change project code.

Fixed `loadDir` so it no longer assumes an `fs.FS` directory implements `fs.ReadDirFile`. It retains the existing partial-read behavior where available and uses `fs.ReadDir` otherwise, returning an error if directory listing is unsupported. Added tests for both fallback cases.

`go test ./scanner` and `go test ./utils` pass. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
